sentences.text: She lived in a small town.
Every day, she went to school and sat in the back of the class.
Her drawings were beautiful, but no one saw them.
One day, her art teacher, Mr. Green, noticed her drawings.
He said, "Lily, your art is amazing! You should show it to others."
She did not want to show her work.
She wanted to find her voice.
That night, she decided to enter an art contest.
The contest was in the big city.
It was a big step for her.
The next day, Lily told her best friend, Mia.
They spent hours working on Lily's piece.
As the contest day came closer, Lily felt nervous.
What if people did not like her art?
But Mia reminded her, "It is not about winning.
It is about sharing your story."
Finally, the day of the contest arrived.
Lily and Mia took the bus to the city.
The city was big and loud.
When it was time to show her art, Lily stood in front of her painting.
It was a picture of a girl standing on a hill.
The girl looked at the sunset.
The colors were bright and warm.
She took a deep breath and spoke.
I feel lost sometimes, but I am finding my way."
Lily felt a wave of happiness.
After the contest, Lily did not win first place, but she won something more important.
She learned that sharing her art was a way to share herself.
From that day on, Lily was no longer just a quiet girl.
She was Lily, and she was proud of who she was.
